17:31 Local Time, 13:31 GMT, 19:01 IST: Honors remain even after a dramatic, multi-phased opening day at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium. Opting to bat on a placid surface, Bangladesh flew out of the blocks. Tanzid Hasan (83) and Shadman Islam scored at over 5 RPO against an inexperienced Afghan attack before Tanzid fell right before lunch. The hosts fought back brilliantly after lunch, grabbing 3 quick wickets, including the big scalp of Mushfiqur Rahim. Yamin Ahmadzai led the charge with a relentless spell, extracting reverse swing in the blistering heat. A gritty 50+ stand steadied Bangladesh before Litton Das reached a hard-fought half-century. However, right after reaching his milestone, Litton suffered a moment of brain fade, holing out in the deep to hand Afghanistan a crucial opening. Saleem capitalized immediately, cleaning up Mahmud with a pinpoint yorker to tilt late control back toward the hosts. Do join us back for Day 2 action! Until then, goodbye and take care!
